integrity: Every displayed count refers to labelled matrices and is derived from the explicit rank-gluing proof; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact ranks for two even cycles identified at one vertex and corresponding incidence-algebra radical Jordan strata; no classification of similarity orbits or overlapping-edge graphs. Prior single-cycle and forest rank formulas are explicitly excluded from the new contribution. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review. Finite experiments are not a substitute for proof.
title: Two-cycle wedge rank polynomials and Jordan strata of finite incidence algebras
